findings.body: The wrong-app refusal runs before checking whether the recorded reader is still installed. If a round was read by the only available app, that app's Forge reader installation is later removed, and the other app becomes available, running `forge read` from the original coordinating app is refused instead of starting fresh with the available reader. Check `installed[recorded]` before applying this refusal, and cover that transition in the round test.
findings.title: Not done: The same reader reads again

findings.body: The changed source brings `src/forge` to 7,613 Python lines. `tests/test_rules.py:62-68` enforces the 7,500-line ceiling set in `pyproject.toml:40`, so the repository test suite fails on this branch. Consolidate enough source to satisfy the existing gate before merging.
findings.title: Bring src/forge back under the enforced line ceiling
